Class TcoComparison

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.tco.TcoComparison
public class TcoComparison extends Object
The result of a TcoCalculator run: a side-by-side cost comparison of the requested DeploymentArchetypes, the recommended approach — the lowest total cost over the commitment term (MRC × months + NRC), so one-time setup charges count — and the saving of the recommended approach versus the public-cloud-over-internet baseline, both per month and over the term.

All figures are design-time estimates; cloud-egress and on-prem inputs are indicative reference figures while Equinix interconnect costs use live pricing where available. See getDisclaimer(). Each breakdown carries the currency its own components reconciled to (see CostBreakdown.getCurrency()), which may differ from the comparison-wide getCurrency(); savings are only computed when baseline and recommended share a currency.
